recognize_zh: CSF 細胞離心抹片在低倍（1a）呈高度細胞性；高倍（1b–1f）可見大量含粗大深紫黑色顆粒、常遮蓋細胞核的嗜鹼性球，與核質比高、細緻染色質、淡藍色細胞質的大型母細胞混雜，在 CML 病人身上提示中樞神經的髓性急性轉變合併嗜鹼性球增生。
features: Panel 1a (low power): markedly cellular CSF cytospin with innumerable nucleated cells
Numerous basophils with coarse, dark purple-black granules that overlie and obscure the nucleus, some degranulating
Large blasts with high N:C ratio, round to indented nuclei, fine open chromatin and occasional nucleoli (panels 1c, 1e, 1f)
Blast cytoplasm is pale to moderately basophilic, some containing a few coarse basophilic granules
Occasional cells with reddish-purple granules and intermediate maturation (basophilic precursors)
describe_en: CSF cytospin preparation is markedly hypercellular at low power. At high power, the cellular population consists of numerous basophils with coarse, dark metachromatic-appearing granules that obscure nuclear detail, admixed with large blasts showing high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, fine chromatin, occasional nucleoli and pale basophilic cytoplasm, some with sparse coarse granules. No normal CSF lymphocyte/monocyte background predominates. In a patient with CML, the findings are consistent with CNS involvement by myeloid blast phase with prominent basophilic differentiation.

ddx.vs: Mast cells have a round central non-lobed nucleus with evenly distributed granules and are tryptase/CD117 bright and CD123 weak, whereas basophils have lobulated nuclei obscured by coarse granules and are CD123+/CD203c+/HLA-DR−.
APL promyelocytes have azurophilic reddish granules with Auer rod bundles and bilobed nuclei, not dark metachromatic basophilic granules.

ddx.dx: Blood contamination (traumatic tap) in CML chronic phase
ddx.vs: A traumatic tap would show numerous RBCs and a mixed granulocytic spectrum mirroring blood, rather than a hypercellular population dominated by blasts and basophils.
Morphologically identical; distinction depends on prior CML history and BCR::ABL1 detection.
